description.en: Renders mermaid code blocks in the conversation and Markdown previews as diagrams. Nothing renders by default: the bundled Mermaid 11.17.0 runtime and per-diagram layout wait for a click, with scroll-into-view and always modes available as alternatives. Diagram colours follow the app's light and dark design tokens, and a rendered diagram can be opened in a fullscreen viewer with zoom and pan.
description.zh: 把对话和 Markdown 预览中的 mermaid 代码块渲染成图表。默认不渲染：内置的 Mermaid 11.17.0 运行时与每张图的布局都等到点击后才发生，另提供滚动可见与立即两种模式。配色跟随应用的明暗设计令牌，渲染后的图表可在全屏查看器中缩放和平移。
